entities.name: Kodolaag
entities.description: A demon performer of the Cult of Rakdos, infatuated with and later husband of Zita.

entities.name: Zita
entities.description: A human effigy mage who runs an effigy shop.

entities.name: Lucinka
entities.description: A fallen Azorius precognition mage who aids them.

entities.name: Azorius
entities.description: The law-enforcing guild that arrests Zita.

entities.name: Bloodfray amulet
entities.description: Amulet used to incite a riot.

events.summary: Kodolaag meets Zita in her shop and fails to invite her to the Mockturne.
events.quote: Kodolaag finally managed to invite Zita to the Mockturne.

events.summary: An Azorius soldier arrests Zita for graffiti modification.
events.quote: an Azorius soldier arrested Zita for a minor offense of graffiti modification.

events.summary: Kodolaag and Olrich visit Lucinka and plan a rescue.
events.quote: Determined to rescue Zita, Kodolaag, and Olrich visited Lucinka, a fallen Azorius precognition mage.

events.summary: At Udzec they reach Zita and disable the guards.
events.quote: they managed to meet Zita and used makeshift blight parchment to disable the guards.

events.summary: Kodolaag and Olrich are caught and imprisoned after Zita and Kodolaag escape.
events.quote: Kodolaag and Olrich were called out by Jitka Wothis , caught, and imprisoned.

events.summary: Kodolaag incites a massive riot, freeing thousands of prisoners.
events.quote: he incited a massive riot, freeing thousands of prisoners.

events.summary: Lucinka tells them to form a new troupe in the undercity and predicts their marriage.
events.quote: they would form a new troupe in the undercity

relations.quote: Kodolaag is a demon , part of the Cult of Rakdos .
He's also the husband of the human Zita.
under threat from his friend Olrich
